patch_description:
Consolidate all eight RY gates in the initial layer to use a single "ry" parameter instead of the even/odd split "rot_init_a"/"rot_init_b". This reduces n_distinct_params from 7 to 6, improving parameter efficiency and generalization.

Rationale:
- All top-scoring programs (0.68) have 6 distinct parameters and converge in 30 steps
- The current program (0.66) has 7 parameters and converges in 60 steps with 46× depth
- Aggressive parameter consolidation is recommended by the optimization framework
- Initial rotation layers serve as data embedding; sharing parameters across all qubits maintains expressivity while reducing overfitting risk
- The entangling blocks provide sufficient differentiation between qubits
